portable_swift_tests.source: Final workflow portable-phase case lines and suite summary; counted separately from native UI.

covered_assertions: Native account/password typing followed by real form POST and authenticated protected HTTP response.
A new tab makes another authenticated HTTP request without another login.
App relaunch uses the persistent cookie with a new synthetic server process and zero new login POSTs.
Native logout expires the cookie and a fresh protected request is denied.
limits: One selected native UI case on iOS18 compact; not a full UI suite or three-device same-source claim.
Existing earlier failed runs remain historical evidence; this success does not replace them.
Synthetic local account only; no external OAuth, MFA, real account or live credential claim.
